title: A trip to the surface
hook: Living underwater does not always mean taking oxygen from water.

knows: Animals have body structures and behaviors.
doesNotKnow: The larva hangs below the line marking the water surface, with its breathing tube reaching air above. Many mosquito larvae breathe at the surface, but respiratory structures and behavior vary across species.

misconception: Every aquatic insect larva necessarily extracts oxygen only from water.
objective: In the illustrated example, a mosquito larva uses a breathing tube at the water surface. Where does the tube connect?

claims.text: Living underwater does not always mean taking oxygen from water. In the illustrated example, a mosquito larva uses a breathing tube at the water surface. Where does the tube connect?
